title: Command palette
summary: Search-and-jump for the whole app: patients, pages and actions in one list, opened with ⌘K. One per app, mounted at the root.

demos.title: Command palette
demos.note: Press ⌘K, or Ctrl+K on Windows, anywhere on this page. Arrow keys move one gliding highlight, Enter runs the item and Escape closes. useCommandShortcut binds the keys.

demos.title: Scoped to a task
demos.note: Any button can open a palette. Items are grouped by their group name, and keywords match words that are not in the label: try 'rx' or 'cholesterol'. Type something that is not there to see the empty message.
